sources.label: Game rigs
sources.description: The gaming PCs running Sunshine this profile can see (those with a game it may play), each with how it's doing, opening its own page.
sources.title: Game PCs

sources.label: A game PC
sources.description: One game PC ($item): with part actions, what can be done to it now (wake it, end what's running, and for an administrator pairing, with the PIN to type into Sunshine); games, its games this profile may play, each starting it on the PC; apps, for an administrator, everything it offers, each shown in its library or not.

sources.label: PCs on the network
sources.description: For an administrator: the PCs on this server's network that answer as Sunshine, each to add with one press. Nothing for anyone else.
sources.title: On your network

sources.label: This server's Sunshine
sources.description: For an administrator: whether Sunshine is installed and running on this server, and a row to offer its games or stop. Nothing for anyone else.
sources.title: This server's Sunshine

commands.label: Wake it
commands.description: Sends a game PC (item: its ID) the wake-up signal, for anyone who can see it.

commands.label: End the game
commands.description: Ends what's running on a game PC (item: its ID): an administrator, or whoever started it from here.

commands.label: Pair
commands.description: Administrators: starts pairing with a game PC (item: its ID); the PIN to type into Sunshine on that PC is shown on the PC's page.

commands.label: Stop pairing
commands.description: Administrators: stops waiting for a PIN from a game PC (item: its ID).

commands.label: Read its games again
commands.description: Administrators: reads a game PC's games again (item: its ID).

commands.label: Remove
commands.description: Administrators: forgets a game PC (item: its ID), its library and its games.

commands.label: Add
commands.description: Administrators: adds a PC found on the network (item: its address and port), which has to answer as Sunshine.

commands.label: Show it
commands.description: Administrators: puts one of a game PC's apps (item: the PC's ID; params.app: the app's) in its library.

commands.label: Hide it
commands.description: Administrators: takes one of a game PC's apps (item: the PC's ID; params.app: the app's) out of its library.

commands.label: Start it on the PC
commands.description: Starts a game PC's game (item: the game's ID) on the PC, to pick up in Moonlight with Resume.

commands.label: Turn on
commands.description: Administrators: offers the games of this server's own Sunshine as a library.

commands.label: Turn off
commands.description: Administrators: stops offering this server's own Sunshine, and takes its library away.

groups.title: Playing in a page
groups.footer: A stream goes from the PC through this server to the browser, at up to its full bitrate. The server doesn't re-encode it.

groups.title: Reaching browsers away from home
groups.footer: Nothing needed at home. Never forward Sunshine's own ports, and never port 47990, its web interface.

rows.label: UDP port
rows.help: One port for every stream, to forward on a router or publish from a container. 0: any free port.
